body: Bayern Munich and Flamengo are in active negotiations, with personal terms already agreed on a five-year deal for winger Mateus Andrade, according to reports from Fabrizio Romano and Kicker.

findings.evidence_quote: Bayern and Flamengo are negotiating the fee, with personal terms already agreed on a five-year deal for the winger.
Bayern's board have opened formal negotiations with Flamengo and see the Brazilian as their top target.
